nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: You tried to bluff your way through my gate.
Now you'll answer for it with steel or coin — your choice.

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: The Veil demands a tithe.
Your blood — or your coin. Either feeds the rift.

choices.text: Cut him down before he finishes the prayer.

lines: He flinches. The sigil burns in the air between you. "...Later, then," he hisses, and retreats.
The sigil does nothing. He smiles.
A flash of orange from the undergrowth.
Something big hits the trail ahead — and it isn't alone.
The beasts circle the empty trail. You regroup a hundred yards down the road.

choices.text: Move on before they catch the scent.

lines: The old burial mound was undisturbed last week.
It isn't now.

choices.text: Take the high ground and hold.

lines: The mound goes still. The cold lifts. Nothing rises.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Road toll's been raised to ten gold. Goblins broke the bridge further north.
(The bridge is visible behind him. Intact.)
You melt into the shadows. He never knew you were there.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The circle is drawn. You've stepped inside it.
The Sovereign sees you now.

choices.text: Fight your way out of the circle.
[Deception - INT] Play along. Pretend to be a pilgrim.

lines: The ritual collapses. The prophet screams a short sharp word. Then he runs.
He nods slowly. "Another pilgrim for the Sovereign's table. Come. The inner sanctum awaits."

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Dust on the horizon — six riders, spread formation.
They've seen us. No point running.

choices.text: Take them before they close the gap.

lines: "Plague-Harvester bounty hunters." The lead rider squints. "You're not who we're looking for. Move along."

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Goblins. A dozen, maybe more.
They look organized. That's new.

choices.text: [Intimidation - STR] Let out a war cry.
[Stealth - DEX] Circle and strike the shaman first.

lines: They break and run, dropping supplies as they go.
The fog closes without warning.
Then the lanterns appear — wrong color, wrong direction.

choices.text: [Nature - INT] Read the fog for a safe path.

lines: The fog breaks in a single narrow corridor. You take it at a dead run.

nodes.speaker: rift_warden
lines: You've been marked since you crossed the gate.
The Veil sees you. It sends its answer.

choices.text: [Arcana] Use the Veil-Lens to blind them.

lines: The shelving units move.
Whatever the library used for guardians — they're still on duty.
"ARCHIVE CLOSED." They freeze mid-reach. Their eyes dim.

choices.text: Browse what's left of the stacks.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Three men, knives already out.
The market's loud enough that no one will hear you shout.

choices.text: [Intimidation - STR] Shout for the Iron Covenant guards.

lines: Iron Covenant halberds appear from two directions. The muggers vanish into the crowd.

nodes.speaker: rift_warden
lines: "Papers."
You don't have papers.

choices.text: "Here are your papers." (20 gold folded inside a credential.)

lines: Smoke-stench before you see them.
Four shapes, low and fast, eyes like coals.

choices.text: [Nature - INT] Throw food to split the pack.

nodes.speaker: faction_envoy_thornpact
lines: Plague Harvesters. They're collecting samples.
You're a sample.

choices.text: Offer them a better bounty. (30 gold)
[Medicine - INT] Prove you're clean. Show your palms.

lines: The lead harvester squints at your palms. "Uninfected. Hm. Move on, then."

nodes.speaker: plague_harvesters
lines: You walk among the dead. Pay the price, or become one of them.
The Harvesters demand a toll.

nodes.speaker: plague_harvesters
lines: You think this place is safe?
You’ll bleed for trespassing.

choices.text: Turn and flee into the mist.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: A figure steps from the shadows, covered in rot and grime.
"Strangers roam the Fen? I’ll collect my due."

choices.text: Offer a gold coin to pass.

lines: The figure narrows its eyes, considering.
"Very well. But beware the dark paths you tread."

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: The Herald approaches, eyes glinting with fervor.
"Your passage is a sin. Offer a sacrifice or perish!"
Shadows writhe near the rift's edge.
Cold laughter echoes — you're not alone.
You melt into the darkness, avoiding their gaze.
They back away, fear flickering in their eyes.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: A figure looms, shrouded in darkness.
"You tread where only ashes should roam. Leave or be consumed."

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: "Halt! The Veil doesn't take kindly to trespassers!"
His eyes narrow. "What brings you to this cursed place?"
A sudden movement — then a chorus of snarls.
Corrupted beasts emerge, eyes glowing with hunger.

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: Your path is barred. The Veil demands tribute.
Your coin or your life — choose swiftly.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: You look lost. This road's not safe anymore.
Hand over your valuables, and you may pass.

choices.text: [Diplomacy - CHA] Convince him to let you pass.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Stop right there. This is Emberguard territory.
You owe me a reason to let you pass.

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: You've wandered into the wrong place, friend.
The Veil is hungry, and you're on the menu.

choices.text: Attempt to negotiate a way through.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: This is no place for the unprepared.
Leave your coin or leave your life.

nodes.speaker: veil_cultist
lines: You tread where the Sovereign beckons not.
Your presence here is an affront — prepare for reckoning.

nodes.speaker: veil_acolyte
lines: This place belongs to the Veil now.
Your intrusion will not be forgiven.

choices.text: [Intimidation - CHA] Try to scare them off.
Offer information about the Emberguard in exchange for safe passage.

lines: They hesitate, backing away. "Not worth the blood," one whispers.
You gain a moment's reprieve as they retreat.

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: You've wandered into territory that bleeds.
The Veil sees you — and demands tribute.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: You think you can just pass by us?
We'll take what we need, one way or another.

choices.text: [Deception - CHA] Pretend to be a guard.

lines: They pause, then laugh. "You're not even a real guard!"
But they lower their weapons, at least for now.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: You’re trespassing. Simple as that.
State your purpose or prepare for consequences.

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: You seek the truth, but you find only shadows.
The Veil will take what is owed.

choices.text: [Intimidation - CHA] Threaten them with your might.

lines: They hesitate, uncertainty flashing in their eyes.
But the resolve hardens quickly, and they stand firm.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Look who wandered off the beaten path!
You’ll regret this decision soon enough.

choices.text: [Stealth - DEX] Try to slip away unnoticed.

lines: You blend into the shadows, unseen.
The bandits scan the area, then move on.

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: You dare tread upon this sacred ground?
Prepare to feed the rift, intruders.

choices.text: [Intimidation - CHA] Threaten them with your presence.
Offer them coin to pass. (30 gold)

lines: He hesitates, then gestures to his followers.
"Leave them, for now. We have bigger prey."

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The rift burns brighter with your folly.
Surrender, or the Veil will consume you.

nodes.speaker: veil_cultist
lines: Your presence defiles this place.
You will pay in blood!

choices.text: [Dexterity - DEX] Create a distraction to evade.

lines: You slip into the shadows, avoiding their wrath.
They growl in frustration as you vanish.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: You thought you could cross here without consequence?
Your path ends in darkness.

choices.text: Draw your weapon against the captain.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: No one crosses the rift without paying a price.
Blood or coin — choose!

nodes.speaker: ashen_veil_herald
lines: You tread on sacred ground. Your presence is a stain.
The Veil demands its due — blood or coin.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Halt! You venture into a patrol zone.
State your intentions or be detained.
He narrows his eyes, surprised. "Not many dare to challenge me..."
You feel the weight of his grip. "You're coming with me."

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: You've wandered off the path, friend.
Tithes are due for those who stray.

choices.text: Offer a minor item as tribute.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: You've got some nerve passing through here.
This road belongs to the Veil; pay your toll.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: You’re lost in Emberwood’s grasp.
Answer quickly or face the consequences.
He raises an eyebrow, respect dawning.
"Very well, you may pass."
He shakes his head. "You don't belong here."

nodes.speaker: plague_harvesters
lines: The fog thickens, and they emerge, grinning beneath their masks.
"Your kind don't belong here. Pay the toll or walk away — quickly."

nodes.speaker: null
lines: A rustle in the reeds, followed by a shriek.
Figures dart through the trees, eyes glowing with hunger.
